# `output(entry = page)` naming a window a package-level `for` declares.
#
# hoistForLoopWindowIDs binds that id at package scope as a list<window> -- one
# window per iteration -- and that binding is an ir.Var like a node handle is.
# Matching on the Go type alone took the handle branch for it, skipped the name
# fallback, and refused the program.
#
# Only internal/build.Check resolves an entry, because only a caller holding the
# whole target registry may say a name nobody declared is a misspelling -- so
# this is a CLI fixture rather than a checker one.

sngl check app.sngl
stdout 'ok'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output(entry = page) {
    none {
        html
    }
}

const items list<string> = ["a", "b"]

for var it = items {
    window #page(title = it, href = "/" + it + ".html") {
        text(value = page.title)
    }
}
